back2basics.text: Statutory bodies like Bar Councils are created by law to regulate professions and ensure governance according to statutory provisions. They must follow procedures prescribed by the relevant Acts, such as the Advocates Act for Bar Councils, to maintain legality and accountability. The Bar Council of India oversees State Bar Councils to ensure compliance with these laws.

2026-10-24-pm-0889d3c3e9.deck: The Bar Council of India (BCI) issued an interim order on October 23, 2026, staying the constitution and operation of committees formed by the Telangana Bar Council. It includes debates, question hours, and special sessions to discuss important national issues. This mechanism is crucial for maintaining democratic governance and ensuring that government policies, especially on sensitive matters like national security, are subject to scrutiny and public accountability.

back2basics.text: A digital identity for farmers is a unique identifier that helps link farmers to various government schemes and services. body.label: Bank of India
body.text: Bank of India contributes banking domain expertise, a nationwide presence, and a high-volume technology environment to test and implement innovations.
